title: Vicmap Planning: planning scheme zone polygons (the zones of Victoria's planning schemes, which say which uses land admits)
provider: State of Victoria, Department of Transport and Planning: Vicmap Planning (VMPLAN_PLAN_ZONE), through the Victorian Government's open data web feature service (GeoServer WFS 2.0.0, layer open-data-platform:plan_zone)
credit: Vicmap Planning: State of Victoria (Department of Transport and Planning), CC BY 4.0
licence: CC BY 4.0 (Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International, stated on https://discover.data.vic.gov.au/dataset/vicmap-planning; checked 2026-11-05)
citation: State of Victoria, Vicmap Planning, https://discover.data.vic.gov.au/dataset/vicmap-planning ; the zones' purposes are the planning schemes' (Melbourne Planning Scheme, https://planning-schemes.app.planning.vic.gov.au/Melbourne)
format: GeoJSON (WGS 84, longitude and latitude): one feature a zone polygon, with pfi and ufi (identifiers), scheme_code (ZN), lga_code and lga (the municipality), zone_num, zone_code (e.g. CCZ1, the Capital City Zone, schedule 1), zone_description, zone_status, gaz_begin_date (the date the zone's polygon was gazetted), and the layer's own dates. A zone's schedule (CCZ1, CCZ2, ...) is part of its code.
coverage: The zones meeting the box, by the WFS's bbox (axis order latitude, longitude for urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::4326); the profile takes the Hoddle Grid's box, -37.8205 to -37.8075 S and 144.9535 to 144.9735 E (37 polygons on 2026-11-05, among them CCZ1, the Capital City Zone, over most of the grid).

south.description: southern edge of the box (degrees, WGS 84)

west.description: western edge of the box (degrees, WGS 84)

north.description: northern edge of the box (degrees, WGS 84)

east.description: eastern edge of the box (degrees, WGS 84)

hoddle-grid.description: The zones of the Hoddle Grid's box (about 0.2 MB; fetch again with --refresh after an amendment of the planning scheme)
